def ppos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; return (min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
def nrow(f):
    # N tiles in player row band (rows 36-42)
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)>=36: out.append((min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print("start player",ppos(current_frame),"N in player row:",nrow(current_frame))
for i in range(5):
    r=action(['LEFT'])
    print(f"L{i+1}: player={ppos(current_frame)} changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
print("N in player row now:",nrow(current_frame))
